answer: Locks are recorded in lotus, expire in wander, and trellis lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 117 aliases as a result needs 138 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1847 identities would post 4172 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
